cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28.1.0)
project(CMAKE_TRY_COMPILE C)
set_property(DIRECTORY PROPERTY INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "")
set(CMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE 1)
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS " -mcpu=cortex-m7 -mfpu=fpv5-d16 -mfloat-abi=hard --multi-lib-config=\"F:\\STM32\\STM32CubeCLT_1.19.0\\st-arm-clang/multilib.gnu_tools_for_stm32.yaml\" --gcc-toolchain=\"F:\\STM32\\STM32CubeCLT_1.19.0\\GNU-tools-for-STM32\\bin/..\" -Wall -fdata-sections -ffunction-sections -mcpu=cortex-m7 -mfpu=fpv5-d16 -mfloat-abi=hard --multi-lib-config=\"F:\\STM32\\STM32CubeCLT_1.19.0\\st-arm-clang/multilib.gnu_tools_for_stm32.yaml\" --gcc-toolchain=\"F:\\STM32\\STM32CubeCLT_1.19.0\\GNU-tools-for-STM32\\bin/..\" -Wall -fdata-sections -ffunction-sections")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} ${COMPILE_DEFINITIONS}")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_DEBUG "-O0 -g3")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "-mcpu=cortex-m7 -mfpu=fpv5-d16 -mfloat-abi=hard --multi-lib-config=\"F:\\STM32\\STM32CubeCLT_1.19.0\\st-arm-clang/multilib.gnu_tools_for_stm32.yaml\" --gcc-toolchain=\"F:\\STM32\\STM32CubeCLT_1.19.0\\GNU-tools-for-STM32\\bin/..\" --gcc-specs=nano.specs -T \"E:/2026volleyball/volleyball/vollleyball_champion/volleyball2_H7/volleyball2_H7_3_18/STM32H723XG_FLASH.ld\" -Wl,-Map=volleyball2_H7.map -Wl,--gc-sections -z noexecstack -Wl,--print-memory-usage ")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} ${EXE_LINKER_FLAGS}")
include_directories(${INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES})
set(CMAKE_SUPPRESS_REGENERATION 1)
link_directories(${LINK_DIRECTORIES})
add_definitions([==[-v]==])
cmake_policy(SET CMP0065 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0083 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0155 OLD)
include("${CMAKE_ROOT}/Modules/Internal/HeaderpadWorkaround.cmake")
set(CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "E:/2026volleyball/volleyball/vollleyball_champion/volleyball2_H7/volleyball2_H7_3_18/build_clang/CMakeFiles/CMakeScratch/TryCompile-ajcri1")
add_library(cmTC_e6f74 STATIC)
target_sources(cmTC_e6f74 PRIVATE
  "F:/STM32/STM32CubeCLT_1.19.0/CMake/share/cmake-3.28/Modules/CMakeCCompilerABI.c"
)
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/cmTC_e6f74_loc"
     CONTENT $<TARGET_FILE:cmTC_e6f74>)
set_property(TARGET cmTC_e6f74 PROPERTY "C_EXTENSIONS" "ON")
set_property(TARGET cmTC_e6f74 PROPERTY "C_STANDARD" "11")
set_property(TARGET cmTC_e6f74 PROPERTY "C_STANDARD_REQUIRED" "ON")
target_link_libraries(cmTC_e6f74 ${LINK_LIBRARIES})
